# CameraClsColor <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Cameras](Blitz3D-Cameras)

</div>


```blitzbasic
CameraClsColor:Void camera:Int32, red:Float32, green:Float32, blue:Float32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `camera` | In | Int32 | required | Camera handle. |
| `red` | In | Float32 | required | Red part, 0 to 255. |
| `green` | In | Float32 | required | Green part, 0 to 255. |
| `blue` | In | Float32 | required | Blue part, 0 to 255. |

## Description

Sets the color this camera clears the buffer to before it draws. The default is black. Each part is clamped to 0 through 255. It only matters while [CameraClsMode](CameraClsMode) leaves color clearing on, which it does by default.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics3D 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
camera = CreateCamera()
CameraClsColor camera, 30, 80, 170
light = CreateLight()
RotateEntity light, 45, 45, 0
ball = CreateSphere(16)
PositionEntity ball, 0, 0, 3
EntityColor ball, 250, 200, 60
RenderWorld
Flip
WaitKey
```
